scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:sim: npm run cap:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/App/build/dd CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:open: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sim && xcrun simctl install booted ios/App/build/dd/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/App.app && xcrun simctl launch booted co.inflect.muster
